clue.text: Minor damage with vehicle shunted at rear is a form of lottery

parts.note: a light mark on paintwork is a scratch

indicators.note: at rear asks for the final letter of the word shunted

explanation.surface: A fender-bender in which a car is bumped from behind turns out to be a gamble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'at rear' takes only the last letter of 'shunted'; the motoring story makes 'shunted' look like part of the accident.
explanation.definitionFit: A card whose coating is rubbed off to reveal a prize is an instant lottery game.

clue.text: Limit put on Italian (old, but unfinished) government building

parts.note: a cap is a limit, as on spending

indicators.note: unfinished means the word old loses its final letter

explanation.surface: A ceiling is placed on an ancient, half-built Italian seat of government.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue, 'put on' sets the limit on top of what follows.
explanation.definitionFit: The building where the US Congress meets in Washington is named for Rome's Capitoline hill.

clue.text: Invertebrate rook oddly found in new hardtop

indicators.note: found in means one group sits inside the other
new signals the letters of hardtop made into a fresh arrangement
oddly asks for the first and third letters of the word rook

explanation.surface: A creepy-crawly turns up in a newly bought hardtop car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' rearranges HARDTOP into ARTH + POD; 'oddly' takes RO from 'rook', which is 'found in' the middle.
explanation.definitionFit: Insects, spiders and crabs are jointed-legged creatures without a backbone, the phylum Arthropoda.

clue.text: Plan talk about source of Rhine

indicators.note: about means one piece wraps around the other
source of a river is its start, so take the first letter of Rhine

explanation.surface: A discussion of where the Rhine rises sets out a plan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'source of' takes the R of Rhine, which CHAT goes 'about'.
explanation.definitionFit: A chart is a map or diagram used to plan a course.

clue.text: Supplier of food for three queens?

parts.note: a queen is a female cat, and ER (Elizabeth Regina) is the crossword queen, twice
a queen is a female cat, and ER (Elizabeth Regina) is the crossword queen, twice
a queen is a female cat, and ER (Elizabeth Regina) is the crossword queen, twice

explanation.surface: Who caters for a trio of monarchs?
explanation.walkthrough: A queen is a female cat; ER stands for Elizabeth Regina. The question mark flags the playful split into three queens.
explanation.definitionFit: A person or firm that provides meals for events is a supplier of food.

clue.text: Answer from soldiers on South Atlantic

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a body of soldiers
S is the compass abbreviation for South
the Atlantic is jokingly called the pond

explanation.surface: Troops stationed in the South Atlantic send back a reply.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The pond' is informal for the Atlantic, as in 'across the pond'.
explanation.definitionFit: To respond is to answer, the verb sense of a reply.

clue.text: Flying jet, so create a form of escape

indicators.note: flying suggests letters scattered through the air, rearranged

explanation.surface: In a jet aircraft, so build a way of getting out.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilot bails out of a stricken aircraft by being fired clear in this device.

clue.text: Packs amounts needed to cover credit

indicators.note: to cover means to sit around another piece

parts.note: CR is the accounting abbreviation for credit

explanation.surface: Money is required to cover a credit balance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Packs' reads like a verb; it is the rugby noun.
explanation.definitionFit: In rugby the forwards' scrummages are their packs binding together.

clue.text: Head back after sailor's major win

indicators.note: after places the sailor first, the reversed piece following
back means the word for head is read backwards

parts.note: top is the head, as of a page

explanation.surface: A captain returns behind a seaman who has struck it rich.
explanation.definitionFit: The top prize in a lottery or on a fruit machine is a big win.

clue.text: A time trial witness

explanation.surface: A timed trial is watched.
explanation.definitionFit: To attest is to bear witness, vouching that something is true.

clue.text: Deliberate pretence of kindness, embracing volunteers

indicators.note: embracing means holding the other piece inside

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve

explanation.surface: Fake niceness, hugging the helpers.
explanation.walkthrough: TA, the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force.
explanation.definitionFit: An artificial manner put on to impress is a studied pretence.

clue.text: Go on about horse

parts.note: a hunter is a horse ridden to hounds

explanation.surface: Rabbit on about a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' looks like a link with 'Go on'; it gives C, from circa.
explanation.definitionFit: To grumble at length, muttering away, is a British sense of going on.

clue.text: Posh type importing pot is to stop operating

indicators.note: importing means bringing another piece inside

parts.note: a toff is an upper-class person
an urn is a pot or vessel

explanation.surface: An aristocrat bringing in a pot is told to shut down.
explanation.definitionFit: To switch off a machine is to make it stop operating.

clue.text: Characters in panto use lewdness, getting the bird

indicators.note: characters means letters, taken from inside the run of words

explanation.surface: Panto innuendo gets the performer jeered off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting the bird' suggests being booed; 'the bird' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An ouzel is an old name for the blackbird, or the ring ouzel thrush.

clue.text: Flier's surprisingly great pride curtailed

indicators.note: surprisingly signals the letters thrown into a new order
curtailed means the word pride loses its tail letter

explanation.surface: Someone's ego is unexpectedly cut down to size.
explanation.walkthrough: 'curtailed' trims PRIDE to PRID; 'surprisingly' rearranges GREAT + PRID.
explanation.definitionFit: A game bird that flies is a flier.

clue.text: Athletic prince at university?

parts.note: a member of the royal family who wins a sports Blue at Oxford or Cambridge

explanation.surface: A sporty royal studying at college.
explanation.walkthrough: A Blue is awarded for representing Oxford or Cambridge at sport; a prince is a royal.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep bright shade of blue, here split as royal plus Blue.

clue.text: Any sadist must be worried in religious occasion

indicators.note: worried suggests the letters agitated into a new order

explanation.surface: Every sadist is anxious at a church festival.
explanation.definitionFit: A feast day honouring a particular holy person is a religious occasion.

clue.text: Gather refusal means hell

parts.note: to gather is to infer, as in deduce

explanation.surface: Deduce that saying no means torment.
explanation.definitionFit: Dante's Inferno names the underworld, so the word stands for hell.

clue.text: Wood's parking fine outside hospital?

indicators.note: outside means the ticket goes around the other piece

parts.note: a ticket is a parking fine
H is the map abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: Is the wood's car park charge levied outside the hospital?
explanation.definitionFit: A dense growth of shrubs and trees is a small wood.

clue.text: Television given to engineers may be adjusted

indicators.note: given to puts the engineers first, with the television set added after them

parts.note: a set is a TV set

explanation.surface: A TV handed to engineers might get tuned.
explanation.definitionFit: Something reset has been set again or readjusted.

clue.text: Plan to redraft top drama tons rejected

indicators.note: redraft means the letters are written out again in another order

parts.note: T is the abbreviation for tons, here taken away

explanation.surface: A scheme to rewrite a hit play, with ton-weight scenes cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' removes T (tons) from TOP DRAMA; 'to redraft' rearranges the remaining OPDRAMA.
explanation.definitionFit: A plan setting out the steps towards a goal is a road map, figuratively.

clue.text: Unfortunately up in the morning for a greeting

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is written bottom to top

explanation.surface: Sadly up early to say hello.
explanation.definitionFit: A low bow with the hand to the forehead is an Eastern greeting.

clue.text: Line adopted by FIFA fixed court trouble

indicators.note: adopted by means taken inside the other piece
fixed signals letters repaired into a new order

explanation.surface: A rule taken up by a corrupt FIFA court causes trouble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fixed' rearranges FIFA to AFFI; L goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To afflict someone is to trouble or distress them.

clue.text: Agreement as Telegraph shows discrimination?

indicators.note: shows means the run is on display inside the words

explanation.surface: This newspaper agrees, showing judgement.
explanation.definitionFit: Taste is the ability to discriminate fine from poor quality.

clue.text: Unhappy tale about pixie going back for flier

indicators.note: about means one piece goes around the other
unhappy suggests letters out of sorts, rearranged
going back means the word is read in reverse

explanation.surface: A sad story about a sprite returning home, for a pamphlet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unhappy' rearranges TALE into LEAT, 'about' FLE, the ELF read backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A flier is a handbill, a printed leaflet handed out.

clue.text: Stops to invest £1000 in Scottish banks

indicators.note: invest means to put money inside, so one piece goes in

parts.note: braes are hillsides or banks in Scotland

explanation.surface: Halts putting a grand into Scottish lenders.
explanation.walkthrough: 'banks' suggests finance; in Scotland a brae is a hillside.
explanation.definitionFit: Brakes stop a vehicle, so the plural noun means stops.

clue.text: Complaint left university doctor with a turn

parts.note: MB is a medical degree, Bachelor of Medicine

explanation.surface: Lower back pain left a university medic dizzy.
explanation.definitionFit: Lumbago, lower back pain, is a medical complaint.

clue.text: Disagreement from centre to new Members of Parliament

indicators.note: new signals the letters formed into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A row between politicians from the centre and newcomers.
explanation.definitionFit: A contretemps is a minor dispute or awkward clash.
